applied.problem: "ln and log give different answers for the same number" fails at 1, where both are 0; and "0 and negative numbers have no logarithm" is absolute, though the ignores panel and the later Complex numbers course give negatives a log of another kind.
"0 and negative numbers have none" and "no power of a positive base makes one" are absolute, read alone in the dossier; they hold only among ordinary (real) numbers, as the ignores panel itself says.
"The ruler is drawn only from 0.001 to 100 000" is true only of the ruler of 10s; the rulers of 2s and e cover the same powers −3 to 5 but other numbers (0.125 to 32, about 0.05 to 148).
Placed right after the ruler of e, "Left of 1 ... 0.1, 0.01 and 0.001 at −1, −2 and −3" reads as true of every ruler; it is the ruler of 10s only (the ruler of 2s has 0.5, 0.25, 0.125 there).
